disclaimer.title: Before you begin
disclaimer.intro: Nodekeeper helps you run your own Bitcoin node and manage ordinals. A few things to understand first:
disclaimer.selfCustody: This is self-custody. You alone hold your keys and your recovery phrase.
disclaimer.noRecovery: Nobody — including Nodekeeper — can recover your funds if you lose your recovery phrase. There is no "forgot password" option.
disclaimer.practiceFirst: Practice on Regtest first. It uses test coins with no real value, so you can try everything safely before using mainnet.
disclaimer.mainnetIsReal: Mainnet uses real bitcoin. Every mainnet transaction is real and, once broadcast, cannot be undone.
